question: What does Acme Cloud actually do?
reply: Acme Cloud is a customer analytics platform for B2B software companies. It connects product usage, billing, and CRM data into live dashboards, smart alerts, and AI-powered insights. This helps teams spot churn risk earlier, find expansion revenue, and avoid rebuilding reports in spreadsheets. It is designed for revenue operations, customer success, product, and finance teams at B2B SaaS companies (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 1-2).

question: How much is the Starter plan?
reply: The Starter plan costs $49 per user per month. It includes up to 10 users, 5 data sources, 1 million events per month, ready-made dashboards, and email support with next business day response. This plan is designed for small teams replacing spreadsheet reporting. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

question: What do I get on the Growth plan and what does it cost?
reply: The Growth plan costs $99 per user per month and includes unlimited users, 25 data sources, 20 million events per month, AI insights and smart alerts, custom health scores, and priority support with a 4-hour response time. It is designed for scaling companies running revenue and product on data. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

question: Is there a free trial?
reply: Yes, Acme Cloud offers a 14-day free trial for the Starter and Growth plans with no credit card required. The Enterprise plan starts with a 30-minute demo with the team (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3).

question: Is there a discount for paying yearly instead of monthly?
reply: Annual billing saves 15% compared to monthly billing for Acme Cloud plans. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)

question: Do you use our data to train your AI models?
reply: Your data is never used to train AI models shared across customers. Acme Cloud ensures that your data and questions remain private and are not used for training shared AI models (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3).

question: How is our data encrypted?
reply: Your data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest with AES-256 encryption. Additionally, Acme Cloud is SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR-ready, with role-based access control and a full audit log of every query and change (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3).

question: Can we keep our data hosted in the EU?
reply: Yes, you can choose EU hosting for your data when you sign up with Acme Cloud. This ensures your data is hosted in the EU region. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

question: Which CRMs can you connect to?
reply: Acme Cloud connects natively to Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM integrations. Data syncs every 15 minutes on Starter and in near real time on Growth and Enterprise plans. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 2)

question: Which plan includes SSO?
reply: SSO (SAML) is included in the Enterprise plan, which also offers SCIM user provisioning, custom data retention, a dedicated customer success manager, and a 99.99% uptime SLA. The Enterprise plan is designed for global companies with advanced security needs. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)

question: How long does it take to get set up?
reply: Most teams see their first live dashboard the same day they connect a data source. Starter customers onboard self-serve with guided setup, Growth customers get a 60-minute onboarding call, and Enterprise customers receive a dedicated customer success manager with a structured 30-day rollout plan (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3).

question: Can I pay for Acme Cloud in Indian rupees?
reply: Acme Cloud's pricing is listed in US dollars and excludes applicable taxes. There is no mention of payment in Indian rupees being available. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)

question: Tell me about the Growth plan. → And how many data sources does that one include?
reply: The Growth plan includes 25 data sources. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)

question: Do you integrate with Zoho CRM?
reply: Acme Cloud does not list Zoho CRM as a native connector. The native integrations include Stripe, Chargebee, Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Zendesk, Intercom, and Slack. Product events can also be sent through SDKs or the REST events API (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 2).

question: Is there an on-premise version I can install on my own servers?
reply: There is no mention of an on-premise version of Acme Cloud for installation on your own servers. The platform is cloud-based with options for data residency in the US or EU. If you want, I can connect you with our team for more details. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide)
